title: 🌙 Ishaan snaps his hands at the torch but the ceiling stays empty... #bedtime #kidsstories
title_alts: 😯 Why does Ishaan's crocodile land on the wall and never the ceiling? #bedtime #kidsstories
💛 Ishaan's crocodile fits one slipper, and his ceiling stays bare... #bedtime #kidsstories
description_hook: Ishaan's shadow crocodile keeps landing on the wall, never the ceiling, and the torch is almost out of light. He has one idea left before lights out.

characters.name: Ishaan
characters.description: seven years old, short black hair, striped pyjamas, a chipped front tooth

scenes.narration: Tonight Ishaan needs a ceiling-sized crocodile, or nobody sleeps. His sister is already waiting.
scenes.caption: आज रात इशान को छत भर का मगरमच्छ चाहिए, वरना कोई नहीं सोएगा।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan, a seven-year-old boy in striped pyjamas with short black hair and a chipped front tooth, kneeling on a low wooden cot in a small bedroom at night, one hand raised toward the plain ceiling, a small metal torch glowing on a stool beside him.

scenes.narration: Ishaan lifts both hands beside the small torch. A shadow lands on the wall.
scenes.caption: इशान ने छोटी टॉर्च के पास दोनों हाथ उठाए। दीवार पर एक परछाई बनी।
scenes.image_brief: Only Ishaan's two raised hands and the lit torch on the stool, warm light spilling past his fingers onto the bedroom wall.

scenes.narration: It is slipper-sized. He wants the whole ceiling.
scenes.caption: परछाई चप्पल जितनी है। उसे पूरी छत चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: The bedroom wall with a small crocodile-shaped shadow no bigger than a slipper, and a real slipper lying on the floorboards below it.

scenes.narration: Every night his sister asks for the crocodile. Every night it stays small.
scenes.caption: हर रात बहन मगरमच्छ माँगती है। हर रात परछाई छोटी ही रहती है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's little sister, a four-year-old in a blue nightdress with two short braids, sitting up in the next cot with her blanket at her chin, facing the dim wall.

scenes.narration: Ishaan bends three fingers into a long snout. He snaps them shut.
scenes.caption: इशान ने तीन उँगलियाँ मोड़कर लंबी नाक बनाई। फिर उन्हें झटके से बंद किया।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's hand held sideways with three fingers curled into a snout shape, the bright torch bulb just behind his knuckles.

scenes.narration: Ishaan whispers it into the dark. One snap, two snap, crocodile!
scenes.caption: इशान अँधेरे में धीरे से बोला। एक चटक, दो चटक, मगरमच्छ!
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan whispering with his mouth close to his own shadowed hands, torch light edging his cheek, the rest of the room dark.

scenes.narration: The wall crocodile snaps back, slipper-sized. The ceiling stays empty.
scenes.caption: दीवार का मगरमच्छ चप्पल जितना ही चटका। छत ख़ाली रही।
scenes.image_brief: The bedroom ceiling, flat and unlit, with the torch glow stopping at the very top of the wall below it.

scenes.narration: Ishaan wants it up there instead. Big enough to swim over both cots.
scenes.caption: इशान को वह ऊपर छत पर चाहिए। इतना बड़ा कि दोनों खाटों के ऊपर तैर सके।
scenes.image_brief: The two low cots side by side seen from the bedroom doorway, both children small in them, the wide empty ceiling above.

scenes.narration: His sister can already do a rabbit. Two fingers, two ears.
scenes.caption: बहन को खरगोश बनाना आता है। दो उँगलियाँ, दो कान।
scenes.image_brief: The little sister's hand making a rabbit with two raised fingers, its shadow falling on the wall next to Ishaan's hands.

scenes.narration: Rabbits are easy. A crocodile needs a whole ceiling.
scenes.caption: खरगोश बनाना आसान है। मगरमच्छ को पूरी छत चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A neat rabbit shadow and a much smaller crocodile shadow side by side on the bedroom wall, low torch light behind them.

scenes.narration: Ishaan has planned this for four nights. Tonight he finishes it.
scenes.caption: इशान चार रातों से यही सोच रहा था। आज रात वह इसे पूरा करेगा।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan sitting cross-legged on his cot with four pencil drawings of crocodiles on torn notebook paper spread in front of him, lit by the torch.

scenes.narration: The torch stands on a wooden stool. Its light makes a wide yellow circle.
scenes.caption: टॉर्च लकड़ी के स्टूल पर खड़ी है। उसकी रोशनी चौड़ा पीला गोला बनाती है।
scenes.image_brief: The torch standing upright on the wooden stool, its wide yellow circle of light printed on the bedroom wall.

scenes.narration: Ishaan kneels on his cot and reaches up. The ceiling stays far away.
scenes.caption: इशान खाट पर घुटनों के बल हाथ ऊपर करता है। छत दूर ही रहती है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan stretched upward on his knees on the cot, fingertips still far below the ceiling, torch light on his back.

scenes.narration: So Ishaan straightens both arms above his head. The shadow climbs the wall.
scenes.caption: तो इशान ने दोनों हाथ सिर के ऊपर सीधे कर दिए। परछाई दीवार पर चढ़ने लगी।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan standing on his cot with both arms straight above his head, a long crocodile shadow climbing the wall behind him.

scenes.narration: At the top it bends. The crocodile folds in half.
scenes.caption: ऊपर पहुँचकर परछाई मुड़ जाती है। मगरमच्छ बीच से आधा मुड़ जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: The crocodile shadow bending sharply where the wall meets the ceiling, its head squashed flat along the corner.

scenes.narration: Ishaan steps back from the torch. The crocodile shrinks.
scenes.caption: इशान टॉर्च से पीछे हटता है। मगरमच्छ छोटा हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan a step back from the stool, his crocodile shadow on the wall shrunk to the size of his palm, light spreading past him.

scenes.narration: He leans in close. It swells across the plaster.
scenes.caption: वह पास झुकता है। परछाई दीवार पर फैल जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan leaning in until his hands almost touch the torch, an enormous crocodile shadow spread over the wall and the closed door.

scenes.narration: Closer to the light means bigger. That rule he has.
scenes.caption: रोशनी के पास जाओ तो परछाई बड़ी होती है। यह बात उसे पता है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's two hands very near the torch bulb, the huge shadow behind them, the wooden edge of the stool in the light.

scenes.narration: But bigger on the wall, not the ceiling. Wrong place.
scenes.caption: पर परछाई दीवार पर बड़ी होती है, छत पर नहीं। जगह ग़लत है।
scenes.image_brief: The bedroom wall filled with a giant crocodile shadow while the ceiling above it stays dark and plain.

scenes.narration: Ishaan tries the edge of the cot. It creaks under him.
scenes.caption: इशान खाट के किनारे पर चढ़ता है। खाट उसके नीचे चरमराती है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan balancing on the narrow wooden edge of his cot with his arms out, torch light throwing his whole body up the wall.

scenes.narration: His sister shushes him. Why does the shadow refuse to climb?
scenes.caption: बहन उसे चुप रहने को कहती है। परछाई ऊपर क्यों नहीं चढ़ती?
scenes.image_brief: The little sister with one finger against her lips in her cot, Ishaan frozen above her on the cot edge, torch glow between them.

scenes.narration: The torch points sideways. So the shadows go sideways.
scenes.caption: टॉर्च बगल की तरफ़ देख रही है। इसलिए परछाइयाँ बगल में जाती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The torch on the stool aimed straight at the wall, a level beam of light crossing the dark room at chest height.

scenes.narration: Ishaan turns his hands upside down. Same wall, same size.
scenes.caption: इशान अपने हाथ उलटे कर लेता है। वही दीवार, वही नाप।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's hands held upside down in the beam, the crocodile shadow appearing on the wall belly-up with its jaw on top.

scenes.narration: He pushes a pillow into the light. A lump appears.
scenes.caption: वह रोशनी में तकिया अड़ाता है। दीवार पर एक ढेला बन जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan holding a flat pillow in front of the torch, a shapeless dark lump printed on the bedroom wall.

scenes.narration: Not a crocodile. A rolled blanket makes a whale.
scenes.caption: यह मगरमच्छ नहीं है। लपेटा हुआ कंबल व्हेल बना देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan holding a tightly rolled blanket in the beam, a fat whale-shaped shadow on the wall, his sister watching from her cot.

scenes.narration: Make a snout with your three fingers too. Ready?
scenes.caption: तुम भी अपनी तीन उँगलियों से लंबी नाक बनाओ। तैयार?
scenes.image_brief: A child's hand with three fingers curled into a snout shape, held in warm torch light against a dark bedroom background.

scenes.narration: Ishaan builds the best jaws yet. Knuckles make the teeth.
scenes.caption: इशान अब तक का सबसे अच्छा जबड़ा बनाता है। पोरों से दाँत बनते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's interlocked hands forming a toothed crocodile jaw, the torch bright behind his knuckles, a sharp shadow on the wall.

scenes.narration: Two hand-spans long. The ceiling would need ten.
scenes.caption: परछाई दो बालिश्त लंबी है। छत के लिए दस चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan measuring the wall shadow with his spread hand, thumb to little finger, the crocodile shape beside his fingers.

scenes.narration: He shoves his hands right against the torch. Light leaks around them.
scenes.caption: वह अपने हाथ टॉर्च से सटा देता है। रोशनी उनके किनारों से छनती है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's hands pressed so close to the torch that light glows red through the edges of his fingers and thumbs.

scenes.narration: The wall crocodile is huge now. One snap, two snap, crocodile!
scenes.caption: दीवार का मगरमच्छ अब बहुत बड़ा है। एक चटक, दो चटक, मगरमच्छ!
scenes.image_brief: A wall-filling crocodile shadow with its jaws wide open, Ishaan's small dark shape below it, the torch blazing behind.

scenes.narration: Still the ceiling above it is bare. Bare as a plate.
scenes.caption: उसके ऊपर छत अब भी ख़ाली है। थाली जैसी ख़ाली।
scenes.image_brief: The upper wall bright with crocodile shadow while the flat ceiling above stays empty, the light stopping at the corner join.

scenes.narration: Ishaan drags the stool nearer the cot. The circle slides up.
scenes.caption: इशान स्टूल को खाट के पास खींचता है। रोशनी का गोला ऊपर सरक जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan dragging the wooden stool across the floorboards with the torch wobbling on top, the light circle sliding upward.

scenes.narration: He tries holding the torch under his chin. It slips out.
scenes.caption: वह टॉर्च को ठुड्डी के नीचे दबाने की कोशिश करता है। वह फिसल जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan tucking the torch under his chin with both hands raised, the beam pointing crookedly down at the floorboards.

scenes.narration: One hand on the torch leaves one hand free. One hand makes a duck.
scenes.caption: एक हाथ टॉर्च पर, तो सिर्फ़ एक हाथ बचता है। एक हाथ से बत्तख़ बनती है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan gripping the torch in one fist and making a one-handed duck shadow with the other hand on the wall.

scenes.narration: A crocodile needs two hands. Someone must hold the torch.
scenes.caption: मगरमच्छ के लिए दो हाथ चाहिए। टॉर्च कोई और पकड़े।
scenes.image_brief: Both of Ishaan's empty hands held open in the beam, the torch standing alone on the stool between his wrists.

scenes.narration: So Ishaan asks his sister to hold it. She sits up.
scenes.caption: तो इशान बहन से टॉर्च पकड़ने को कहता है। वह उठ बैठती है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan passing the torch to his little sister across the gap between the two cots, light swinging between their faces.

scenes.narration: She takes it and turns it on her own hands.
scenes.caption: वह टॉर्च लेकर उसे अपने ही हाथों की तरफ़ घुमा देती है।
scenes.image_brief: The sister holding the torch turned toward her own raised fingers, a rabbit shadow appearing on her side of the room.

scenes.narration: His sister wants the ceiling too. For a rabbit.
scenes.caption: बहन को भी छत चाहिए। अपने खरगोश के लिए।
scenes.image_brief: The sister kneeling on her cot pointing the torch upward, a thin stretched rabbit shadow wobbling above her head.

scenes.narration: Now two children want one small torch. Nobody lets go.
scenes.caption: अब दो बच्चे एक छोटी टॉर्च चाहते हैं। कोई नहीं छोड़ता।
scenes.image_brief: Both children's hands gripping the same torch in the middle of the dark bedroom, the beam pinched between their fingers.

scenes.narration: Ishaan pulls. His sister pulls harder.
scenes.caption: इशान खींचता है। बहन उससे ज़्यादा ज़ोर से खींचती है।
scenes.image_brief: A tug of war over the torch between Ishaan and his sister, her blanket sliding off the cot, light streaking over the ceiling.

scenes.narration: The torch drops onto the floorboards. It rolls.
scenes.caption: टॉर्च फ़र्श के तख़्तों पर गिर जाती है। वह लुढ़कती है।
scenes.image_brief: The torch fallen on bare floorboards, still lit, rolling past a pair of slippers, its beam sweeping the room.

scenes.narration: The ring at its front twists loose. The glass slides sideways.
scenes.caption: उसके आगे का छल्ला ढीला हो जाता है। काँच बगल में सरक जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: The fallen torch on the floor with its front ring unscrewed and the round glass disc tilted out of place.

scenes.narration: The wide yellow circle is gone. Now the light comes out in a stripe.
scenes.caption: चौड़ा पीला गोला ग़ायब है। अब रोशनी पट्टी बनकर निकलती है।
scenes.image_brief: A narrow bar of torchlight lying across the floorboards, the walls and ceiling of the bedroom in darkness.

scenes.narration: Three fingers wide. The circle had covered half the wall.
scenes.caption: तीन उँगली चौड़ी। पहले गोला आधी दीवार ढक लेता था।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan holding three fingers against the thin stripe of light on the floor to measure how wide it is.

scenes.narration: Ishaan's whole crocodile will not fit in a stripe. Only its nose.
scenes.caption: इशान का पूरा मगरमच्छ पट्टी में नहीं समाता। सिर्फ़ उसकी नाक।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's joined hands inside the narrow band of light with only a small crocodile nose showing as shadow on the wall.

scenes.narration: He snaps it anyway. One snap, two snap, crocodile!
scenes.caption: वह फिर भी चटकाता है। एक चटक, दो चटक, मगरमच्छ!
scenes.image_brief: A tiny crocodile nose shadow closing inside a narrow band of light on the wall, Ishaan's face dim beside it.

scenes.narration: A nose snaps in a stripe. That is all.
scenes.caption: पट्टी में सिर्फ़ एक नाक चटकती है। बस इतना ही।
scenes.image_brief: The thin stripe on the wall holding one small dark shape, the rest of the wall completely black.

scenes.narration: His sister's rabbit does not fit either. Two ears, no room.
scenes.caption: बहन का खरगोश भी नहीं समाता। दो कान, जगह नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: The sister's two rabbit-ear fingers squeezed into the thin light with only one ear tip showing as shadow.

scenes.narration: She says the torch is spoiled. She says it is his fault.
scenes.caption: वह कहती है टॉर्च बिगड़ गई। और यह इशान की ग़लती है।
scenes.image_brief: The sister sitting with folded arms in her cot facing away, the broken torch lying on the floor between the cots.

scenes.narration: Their grandmother speaks from the doorway. Ten minutes, then lights out.
scenes.caption: दादी दरवाज़े से कहती हैं। दस मिनट, फिर बत्ती बंद।
scenes.image_brief: The grandmother in a shawl standing in the bedroom doorway with hallway light behind her, both children looking up at her.

scenes.narration: Ten minutes. Two children. One stripe of light.
scenes.caption: दस मिनट। दो बच्चे। रोशनी की एक पट्टी।
scenes.image_brief: The thin stripe of light on the floorboards with two pairs of small bare feet on either side of it.

scenes.narration: Grandmother offers to mend the torch tomorrow. Tomorrow is too late.
scenes.caption: दादी कहती हैं कल टॉर्च ठीक कर देंगी। कल बहुत देर हो जाएगी।
scenes.image_brief: The grandmother holding up one open palm in the doorway as she speaks, the loose torch still lying on the floorboards.

scenes.narration: Ishaan tries the old way, faster. The stripe slices his crocodile thin.
scenes.caption: इशान पुराना तरीक़ा जल्दी-जल्दी दोहराता है। पट्टी उसके मगरमच्छ को पतला काट देती है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's hands working quickly in the narrow beam, a sliver of crocodile shadow flickering on the wall.

scenes.narration: He twists the loose glass to widen it. It rattles and stays narrow.
scenes.caption: वह ढीले काँच को घुमाकर पट्टी चौड़ी करना चाहता है। वह खड़खड़ाती है, पतली ही रहती है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan sitting on the floor turning the torch's loose front glass with both thumbs, the thin beam shaking on the wall.

scenes.narration: Eight minutes. His sister will not look up.
scenes.caption: आठ मिनट। बहन ऊपर नहीं देखती।
scenes.image_brief: The sister lying down facing the wall with her blanket over one ear, the lit stripe crossing the floor behind her.

scenes.narration: Ishaan sets the torch on the stool again. The stripe lands flat.
scenes.caption: इशान टॉर्च को फिर स्टूल पर रखता है। पट्टी सीधी पड़ जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: The torch lying on its side on the wooden stool, its narrow beam falling in a long line across the floorboards.

scenes.narration: He does not want a wall crocodile. He wants the ceiling.
scenes.caption: उसे दीवार का मगरमच्छ नहीं चाहिए। उसे छत चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan sitting back on his heels on the floor with his chin lifted toward the dark, empty ceiling.

scenes.narration: Six minutes left. The stripe lies long and thin.
scenes.caption: छह मिनट बचे हैं। पट्टी लंबी और पतली पड़ी है।
scenes.image_brief: A long thin band of light stretching from the foot of the stool across the floorboards to the bedroom door.

scenes.narration: Long and thin is crocodile-shaped. But it is on the floor.
scenes.caption: लंबी और पतली चीज़ मगरमच्छ जैसी होती है। पर वह फ़र्श पर है।
scenes.image_brief: The long stripe of light on the floorboards, narrow like a crocodile lying down, the ceiling above it in darkness.

scenes.narration: Ishaan stacks his four story books on the stool.
scenes.caption: इशान अपनी चार कहानी की किताबें स्टूल पर चढ़ा देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan piling four thick story books one on top of another on the wooden stool, the loose torch lit beside his knee.

scenes.narration: He wedges the torch on top, face up. It points at the ceiling.
scenes.caption: वह टॉर्च को सबसे ऊपर फँसा देता है, मुँह ऊपर। वह छत की तरफ़ देखती है।
scenes.image_brief: The torch standing upright and wedged on a stack of four books on the stool, its beam shooting straight up.

scenes.narration: The stripe leaves the floor. It lies across the ceiling.
scenes.caption: पट्टी फ़र्श छोड़ देती है। वह छत के आर-पार पड़ जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A long bright band of light lying across the bedroom ceiling above the two cots, the rest of the room dark.

scenes.narration: A stripe on a ceiling is already crocodile-shaped. Long. Thin.
scenes.caption: छत पर पड़ी पट्टी पहले से मगरमच्छ जैसी है। लंबी। पतली।
scenes.image_brief: The band of light on the ceiling seen from Ishaan's pillow, its soft edges and the ceiling boards showing inside it.

scenes.narration: Now both his hands are free. The books hold the torch.
scenes.caption: अब उसके दोनों हाथ ख़ाली हैं। किताबें टॉर्च को थामे हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's two open empty hands on either side of the book stack, the propped torch glowing upward between them.

scenes.narration: Ishaan slides his hands just above the glass. Closer means bigger.
scenes.caption: इशान अपने हाथ काँच के थोड़ा ऊपर ले जाता है। पास जाओ तो बड़ा होता है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's interlocked jaw-shaped hands held low over the upward-pointing torch, light blazing through the gaps.

scenes.narration: The jaws unroll from the door to the window.
scenes.caption: जबड़ा दरवाज़े से खिड़की तक फैल जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: An enormous crocodile jaw shadow stretching across the whole ceiling from above the door to above the window.

scenes.narration: Huge. Longer than both cots together.
scenes.caption: बहुत बड़ा। दोनों खाटों से भी लंबा।
scenes.image_brief: The ceiling crocodile shadow spanning above both cots, the two children tiny underneath it on their blankets.

scenes.narration: But the stripe is narrow. The legs fall outside it.
scenes.caption: पर पट्टी पतली है। पैर उसके बाहर रह जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The ceiling crocodile with its body inside the band of light and its leg shapes lost in the dark beside the band.

scenes.narration: A crocodile needs feet. Ishaan has no hands left.
scenes.caption: मगरमच्छ को पैर चाहिए। इशान के पास और हाथ नहीं हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's hands fully busy making the jaw above the torch, his elbows locked, nothing else of him free.

scenes.narration: So Ishaan asks for her rabbit, not her torch.
scenes.caption: तो इशान उससे टॉर्च नहीं, उसका खरगोश माँगता है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan turning his head toward his sister while his hands stay in the beam, the sister lifting her head off the pillow.

scenes.narration: Two ears slide in under his jaws. She holds them still.
scenes.caption: दो कान उसके जबड़े के नीचे आ जाते हैं। वह उन्हें स्थिर रखती है।
scenes.image_brief: The sister's two-fingered rabbit hand entering the beam just below Ishaan's joined hands, both sets of fingers lit.

scenes.narration: Now you say it with Ishaan, out loud.
scenes.caption: अब तुम इशान के साथ ज़ोर से बोलो।
scenes.image_brief: Two children's hands together in one upward beam of light, their mouths open mid-word, the bright ceiling above.

scenes.narration: Both of them say it. One snap, two snap, crocodile!
scenes.caption: दोनों साथ बोलते हैं। एक चटक, दो चटक, मगरमच्छ!
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan and his sister kneeling side by side at the stool, faces lit from below, the ceiling crocodile shut above them.

scenes.narration: On the ceiling the ears become two waving feet.
scenes.caption: छत पर वे कान दो हिलते हुए पैर बन जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The ceiling crocodile with two small waving foot shapes under its long body, everything inside the band of light.

scenes.narration: Then she edges her hands nearer. Her rabbit fills the ceiling too.
scenes.caption: फिर वह अपने हाथ और पास ले जाती है। उसका खरगोश भी पूरी छत भर देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A giant rabbit shadow with tall ears filling the ceiling band, the sister's hands close over the torch, Ishaan leaning back.

scenes.narration: One stripe. Two animals. Turns, not pulling.
scenes.caption: एक पट्टी। दो जानवर। खींचातानी नहीं, बारी-बारी।
scenes.image_brief: The band of light on the ceiling with a crocodile shadow at one end and a rabbit shadow at the other end.

scenes.narration: The crocodile swims over his sister's cot. She pulls up her blanket.
scenes.caption: मगरमच्छ बहन की खाट के ऊपर तैरता है। वह कंबल ऊपर खींच लेती है।
scenes.image_brief: The sister on her back in her cot with the crocodile shadow moving across the ceiling directly above her face.

scenes.narration: The rabbit hops along its back. Nobody argues.
scenes.caption: खरगोश उसकी पीठ पर उछलता है। कोई झगड़ा नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: The rabbit shadow hopping along the crocodile's ceiling back, both shapes held inside the same lit band.

scenes.narration: Ishaan counts the ceiling boards it covers. Six.
scenes.caption: इशान गिनता है कि यह छत के कितने तख़्ते ढकता है। छह।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan pointing up and counting ceiling boards, six of them crossed by the shadow, his sister following his finger.

scenes.narration: Bigger than the crocodile he planned for four nights.
scenes.caption: उस मगरमच्छ से भी बड़ा, जो वह चार रातों से सोच रहा था।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's four pencil drawings lying forgotten on his cot while the real ceiling shadow stretches overhead.

scenes.narration: Nobody is holding the torch at all. The books do.
scenes.caption: टॉर्च को कोई पकड़े हुए नहीं है। किताबें पकड़े हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The unattended torch upright on the four books, both children's hands resting loose on the floorboards beside it.

scenes.narration: Grandmother looks in and says nothing. The door stays open a hand's width.
scenes.caption: दादी झाँककर देखती हैं और कुछ नहीं कहतीं। दरवाज़ा एक हाथ भर खुला रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: The grandmother half in the doorway with a small smile, the lit ceiling shadow visible past her shoulder.

scenes.narration: His sister's eyes close under the crocodile.
scenes.caption: बहन की आँखें मगरमच्छ के नीचे मुँद जाती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The sister asleep with her cheek on the pillow, the crocodile shadow spread wide on the ceiling above her.

scenes.narration: She asks for one more snap. Ishaan gives her three.
scenes.caption: वह एक और चटक माँगती है। इशान उसे तीन देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's hands snapping the jaw shape above the torch, the ceiling crocodile's mouth opening and closing.

scenes.narration: Then the light goes thin and orange. The battery is finishing.
scenes.caption: फिर रोशनी पतली और नारंगी हो जाती है। बैटरी ख़त्म हो रही है।
scenes.image_brief: The torch beam dimmed to a weak orange, the ceiling crocodile faint and blurred at its edges.

scenes.narration: The ceiling goes dark. Ishaan knows exactly where it sleeps.
scenes.caption: छत अँधेरी हो जाती है। इशान को पता है वह कहाँ सोया है।
scenes.image_brief: The dark bedroom with only a line of hallway light, both cots dim, the ceiling plain and quiet above them.

scenes.narration: The books stay on the stool for tomorrow.
scenes.caption: किताबें कल के लिए स्टूल पर ही रहती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The stack of four books on the stool with the switched-off torch balanced on top, lit only by hallway light.

scenes.narration: Ishaan lies back and wants this minute to stay.
scenes.caption: इशान लेट जाता है और चाहता है कि यह पल ठहर जाए।
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan on his back with his hands behind his head, smiling up at the dark ceiling, his sister asleep nearby.

scenes.narration: His sister whispers something into the dark. Ishaan answers it exactly.
scenes.caption: बहन अँधेरे में धीरे से कुछ कहती है। इशान ठीक वही जवाब देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two dark cots with the children's faces just visible, the door ajar behind them letting in a thin line of light.

scenes.narration: One snap, two snap, crocodile!
scenes.caption: एक चटक, दो चटक, मगरमच्छ!
scenes.image_brief: Ishaan's hand resting on his blanket with two fingers lightly touching, the dark ceiling above, a thin line of hallway light on the wall.
